add_to_queue.description: Add an item to the end of a Modal Queue, such as a job for a worker to pick up. The Queue is made if it doesn't exist.
add_to_queue.name: add_to_queue

parameters.description: The Modal Queue. Pick one, or type a name.
parameters.name: queue_name

parameters.description: Text, a number, or JSON such as {"job": 42}; JSON is stored as the list or dict it describes, so your Modal code reads it as one.
parameters.name: value

length.description: How many items the Queue now holds

cancel_function_call.description: Stop a function call started with 'Start function call'.
cancel_function_call.name: cancel_function_call

parameters.description: The call's ID from 'Start function call', starting with fc-.
parameters.name: call_id

parameters.description: Shut down the containers running it at once, rather than letting them finish their other work.
parameters.name: terminate_containers

create_secret.description: Save keys or passwords as a new Secret that your Modal functions can use as environment variables. Fails if one by that name exists.
create_secret.name: create_secret

parameters.description: A name for the Secret: letters, digits, dashes, periods and underscores.
parameters.name: secret_name

parameters.description: The environment variable names and values the Secret holds, such as {"OPENAI_API_KEY": "sk-..."}. Your Modal code reads them as environment variables.
parameters.name: variables

create_volume.description: Create a new, empty Volume. Fails if one by that name exists.
create_volume.name: create_volume

parameters.description: A name for the Volume: letters, digits, dashes, periods and underscores.
parameters.name: volume_name

delete_dict.description: Delete a Modal Dict and everything stored in it.
delete_dict.name: delete_dict

parameters.description: The Modal Dict. Pick one, or type a name.
parameters.name: dict_name

delete_file.description: Delete a file, or a folder and everything in it, from a Volume.
delete_file.name: delete_file

parameters.description: The Modal Volume. Pick one, or type its name.
parameters.name: volume_name

parameters.description: The file's path in the Volume, such as /results/output.json.
parameters.name: path

parameters.description: Needed to delete a folder that has files in it.
parameters.name: recursive

delete_queue.description: Delete a Modal Queue and every item still in it.
delete_queue.name: delete_queue

parameters.description: The Modal Queue. Pick one, or type a name.
parameters.name: queue_name

delete_secret.description: Delete a Secret. Apps that use it can no longer start until it is replaced.
delete_secret.name: delete_secret

parameters.description: The Modal Secret. Pick one, or type its name.
parameters.name: secret_name

delete_volume.description: Delete a Volume and every file in it. This can't be undone.
delete_volume.name: delete_volume

parameters.description: The Modal Volume. Pick one, or type its name.
parameters.name: volume_name

get_app.description: Get one app: its state, its functions, and when and by whom it was created, deployed or stopped.
get_app.name: get_app

parameters.description: The deployed Modal app. Pick one, or type its name.
parameters.name: app_name

app_id.description: The app's ID, starting with ap-

description.description: The app's description, usually its name

functions.description: The names of the app's functions

servers.description: The names of the app's web servers

state.description: deployed, ephemeral, detached, stopping or stopped

version.description: Which deployment of the app this is

get_dict_value.description: Read the value stored under a key in a Modal Dict.
get_dict_value.name: get_dict_value

parameters.description: The Modal Dict. Pick one, or type a name.
parameters.name: dict_name

parameters.description: The key the value is stored under.
parameters.name: key

found.description: False when the Dict has no such key

value.description: The value, or null when not found

list_apps.description: List the apps in your Modal environment that are deployed or running, newest first, with their functions and when they were deployed.
list_apps.name: list_apps

app_id.description: The app's ID, starting with ap-

description.description: The app's description, usually its name

functions.description: The names of the app's functions

servers.description: The names of the app's web servers

state.description: deployed, ephemeral, detached, stopping or stopped

version.description: Which deployment of the app this is

list_files.description: List the files and folders in a Volume, in one folder or everything under it.
list_files.name: list_files

parameters.description: The Modal Volume. Pick one, or type its name.
parameters.name: volume_name

parameters.description: The folder to list, such as /results. Leave empty for the top.
parameters.name: path

parameters.description: Also list everything inside the folders it contains.
parameters.name: recursive

mtime.description: When it was last written, in Unix seconds

path.description: The path in the Volume, such as /results/out.json

list_secrets.description: List the Secrets (saved passwords and keys for your Modal code) in your environment.
list_secrets.name: list_secrets

list_volumes.description: List the Volumes (shared storage your Modal code reads and writes) in your environment.
list_volumes.name: list_volumes

read_file.description: Read a file from a Volume, up to 5 MB. Text comes back as text; anything else as base64.
read_file.name: read_file

parameters.description: The Modal Volume. Pick one, or type its name.
parameters.name: volume_name

parameters.description: The file's path in the Volume, such as /results/output.json.
parameters.name: path

encoding.description: text, or base64 for a file that isn't text

run_command.description: Run a shell command in a fresh, isolated container on Modal, on a GPU if you pick one, wait for it to end, and return its output and exit code. The container is removed afterwards.
run_command.name: run_command

parameters.description: The shell command to run, such as python -c "print(2 + 2)". Several lines run one after another.
parameters.name: command

parameters.description: A public image from Docker Hub or another registry, such as python:3.13-slim or pytorch/pytorch:latest. Leave empty for Modal's standard Debian image with Python.
parameters.name: image

parameters.description: A GPU to attach. Leave empty to run on CPU only.
parameters.name: gpu

parameters.description: How many of that GPU, 1 to 8. Defaults to 1.
parameters.name: gpu_count

parameters.description: CPU cores to reserve, such as 0.5 or 4. Defaults to Modal's.
parameters.name: cpu

parameters.description: Memory to reserve, in megabytes. Defaults to Modal's.
parameters.name: memory_mb

parameters.description: Stop the command after this long, 10 to 600 seconds. Defaults to 300.
parameters.name: timeout_seconds

parameters.description: Secrets whose values the command gets as environment variables.
parameters.name: secret_names

parameters.description: A Volume to make available at /data, to read inputs from or save results to.
parameters.name: volume_name

parameters.description: The app the sandbox is filed under in Modal's dashboard. Defaults to lodol-sandboxes, made the first time it's used.
parameters.name: app_name

app_name.description: The app the sandbox ran under

exit_code.description: The command's exit code; 0 means success

output_truncated.description: True when only the last million characters were kept

succeeded.description: True when the exit code is 0

run_function.description: Call a function in one of your deployed Modal apps with the arguments you give, wait for it to finish (up to the time you set) and return what it returned.
run_function.name: run_function

parameters.description: The deployed Modal app. Pick one, or type its name.
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.description: The function in that app, by the name it has in your code (for a class method, ClassName.method).
parameters.name: function_name

parameters.description: The function's inputs, by parameter name: for def summarize(text, length) give {"text": "...", "length": 3}. Leave empty for a function that takes none.
parameters.name: arguments

parameters.description: How long to wait for the result, 1 to 600 seconds. Defaults to 60. For longer jobs use 'Start function call'.
parameters.name: wait_seconds

set_dict_value.description: Store a value under a key in a Modal Dict, a shared store your Modal code can read. The Dict is made if it doesn't exist.
set_dict_value.name: set_dict_value

parameters.description: The Modal Dict. Pick one, or type a name.
parameters.name: dict_name

parameters.description: The key the value is stored under.
parameters.name: key

parameters.description: Text, a number, or JSON such as {"job": 42}; JSON is stored as the list or dict it describes, so your Modal code reads it as one.
parameters.name: value

start_function_call.description: Start a function in one of your deployed Modal apps and carry on without waiting. Use the call ID with 'Wait for function call' to get its result, or 'Cancel function call' to stop it.
start_function_call.name: start_function_call

parameters.description: The deployed Modal app. Pick one, or type its name.
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.description: The function in that app, by the name it has in your code (for a class method, ClassName.method).
parameters.name: function_name

parameters.description: The function's inputs, by parameter name: for def summarize(text, length) give {"text": "...", "length": 3}. Leave empty for a function that takes none.
parameters.name: arguments

call_id.description: The call's ID, starting with fc-

stop_app.description: Stop an app: its running containers and sandboxes shut down and its functions stop taking calls until it is deployed again.
stop_app.name: stop_app

parameters.description: The deployed Modal app. Pick one, or type its name.
parameters.name: app_name

take_from_queue.description: Take the next item off a Modal Queue (it is removed from the Queue). Returns found false when the Queue is empty.
take_from_queue.name: take_from_queue

parameters.description: The Modal Queue. Pick one, or type a name.
parameters.name: queue_name

parameters.description: How long to wait when the Queue is empty, 0 to 60 seconds. Defaults to 0: don't wait.
parameters.name: wait_seconds

found.description: False when the Queue was empty

value.description: The item, or null when the Queue was empty

update_secret.description: Add or change values in a Secret, such as a new API key. Values you don't name stay as they are.
update_secret.name: update_secret

parameters.description: The Modal Secret. Pick one, or type its name.
parameters.name: secret_name

parameters.description: The environment variable names and values the Secret holds, such as {"OPENAI_API_KEY": "sk-..."}. Your Modal code reads them as environment variables.
parameters.name: variables

wait_for_function_call.description: Wait until a function call started with 'Start function call' finishes and return its result. While it runs, the workflow pauses and looks again every minute.
wait_for_function_call.name: wait_for_function_call

parameters.description: The call's ID from 'Start function call', starting with fc-.
parameters.name: call_id

write_file.description: Save text (or base64 data) as a file in a Volume, up to 5 MB, for your Modal code to read. Folders in the path are made as needed.
write_file.name: write_file

parameters.description: The Modal Volume. Pick one, or type its name.
parameters.name: volume_name

parameters.description: Where to save it in the Volume, such as /inputs/data.csv.
parameters.name: path

parameters.description: What to put in the file.
parameters.name: content

parameters.description: Turn on when the contents are a file encoded as base64 rather than text.
parameters.name: content_is_base64

parameters.description: Replace a file already at that path. When off, an existing file stops the step.
parameters.name: overwrite

description: Run your Modal functions and GPU jobs from a workflow: call deployed functions and get their results, run commands in sandboxes, stop apps, and manage Secrets, Volumes and their files, Dicts and Queues.

modal_app_deployed_trigger.description: Runs when an app in your Modal environment is deployed, for the first time or again. Deployments from before it's turned on don't start runs.

parameters.description: Only this app. Leave empty for any app.
parameters.name: app_name

modal_volume_file_trigger.description: Runs when a file is added to a Modal Volume or rewritten, such as results a job saved. Files already there when it's turned on don't start runs.
modal_volume_file_trigger.display_name: New or changed file in a volume

parameters.description: The Volume to watch.
parameters.name: volume_name

parameters.description: Only files in this folder and its subfolders, such as /results. Leave empty for the whole Volume.
parameters.name: path
